clips.title: The story
paras: During the Lunar Festival, Silvervein the Elder appears on the hills above Thelsamar in Loch Modan. Travelers honor him and the ancient ties among Azeroth’s elder peoples, and he grants an ancestral blessing in return.

Above Thelsamar, Silvervein watches the ridges in silence. During the Lunar Festival, travelers honor him as a keeper of memories from ages past. Below, Loch Modan faces trogg invasions and local disputes, while the elder spirit remains peaceful on his overlook.
Travelers who seek Silvervein find gratitude for their homage to Azeroth’s olden races. His greeting honors those who remember the ancient peoples, and he offers them a commemorative token.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, friend, and offer you this token...
